documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: An earlier inquiry from our field services team requested discovery about missed handoffs. The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement. Please clarify the contradictory project information before proposing a meeting.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer's operational friction involves 'missed handoffs' and a 'project paused' status, with conflicting information about the requirement. The field services team previously requested discovery, but the current project owner disagrees, creating uncertainty. The account is qualified with consent, but the contradictory project status blocks clear next steps.

claims.quote: An earlier inquiry from our field services team requested discovery about missed handoffs.
The latest call says the project is paused and the owner disagrees about the requirement.

raw_proposal.draft: We understand that your field services team previously requested discovery about missed handoffs, but the project is currently paused, and there appears to be a disagreement about the requirement. To ensure we align with your needs, could you clarify the current status of the project and confirm whether the requirement for workflow coordination is still valid? This will help us proceed effectively.
questions: Could you clarify the current status of the project and whether the requirement for workflow coordination is still valid?
Are there any specific details about the missed handoffs that you'd like us to focus on during discovery?
uncertainties: Conflicting project status (paused vs. requirement in question).
Unclear if the requirement for workflow coordination is still valid.
